maria (ML Eng): FYI ran the initial bring-up for lyra-11b (FP16 / int8 / int4) on the sample GTN prompt set. Posting a short summary and proposed routing.
maria (ML Eng): Quick numbers: baseline fp16 cost = $1.00 per 1M tokens (normalized). int8 ~= $0.36 (2.8x cheaper), int4 ~= $0.28 (3.6x cheaper). Latency P50: fp16 85ms, int8 110ms, int4 135ms on our A100 pool.
samir (Research): Quality delta on eval sets: int8 = -1.4% micro-F1 / -1.2% ROUGE-L vs fp16. int4 = -4.3% / -3.9%. Human pairwise: int8 preferred vs int4 by 68% on generative tasks.
elaine (Eval): We ran the product-critical prompt slice (billing/answers/summary). Observed hallucination uptick on int4 for long-context summarization ( > 1k tokens). int8 is within noise for short prompts.
maria (ML Eng): Recommendation (short): default -> lyra-11b-int8 for self-serve and most GTN flows. Reserve fp16 fallback for high-precision routes (A/B, legal, billing). Defer int4 for extreme cost experiments only; not ready for general rollout.
devin (Product): How do you suggest we expose this to customers? single model id with routing flags or multiple model ids?
maria (ML Eng): Prefer single model id + routing policy. Example config we tested:

```
routing_policy:
  - condition: request.metadata.priority == "high"
    model_variant: lyra-11b-fp16
  - condition: true
    model_variant: lyra-11b-int8
    weight: 1.0
fallbacks:
  - lyra-11b-fp16
```

maria (ML Eng): This keeps footprint small in Console and enables automatic fallback on quality regressions.
zhen (SRE): What's the estimated GPU footprint if we shift 80% traffic to int8? We need to ensure autoscaler profiles.
maria (ML Eng): Rough calc: int8 throughput per GPU ~= 3.2x fp16 tokens/s. So for current steady 2M tokens/s, we go from ~X GPUs fp16 to ~0.4X GPUs int8. Need to keep a pool of hot fp16 nodes at ~0.2X for fallbacks and canary traffic.
zhen (SRE): Ok, update autoscaler policy and warm pool config. I'll add a canary spike plan.
samir (Research): One more note: for long-context (>4k) generation the int8 kernel shows higher variance on latency tail; recommend we route long sequences to fp16 regardless.
elaine (Eval): Adding metrics we should monitor in Console: per-route token cost, human-eval delta, hallucination rate on golden set, latency P95, and rollback triggers (e.g., >2% accuracy drop over baseline for 30m).
ops-bot: deploy:canary started lyra-11b-int8 on prod-canary at 2419877200
maria (ML Eng): Proposed rollout steps:
1) Canary 1% traffic to int8 for 6h with golden prompt checks every 15m.
2) If pass, 10% for 24h with autoscaling adjustments.
3) 60% for 48h, keep 30% fp16 warm capacity.
4) Full default switch if metrics stable for 7d.
devin (Product): For GTN messaging: call out ~2.8x cost savings with "negligible quality uplift" (but be careful with language on hallucinations). We'll provide 'high-fidelity' toggle that maps to fp16.
maria (ML Eng): Suggested docs blurb for Console:

"Lyra-11b default uses an int8-optimized runtime to reduce inference cost. Toggle 'High fidelity' to prioritize FP16 for tasks requiring maximal accuracy or long-context stability."
samir (Research): Action items for ML:
- run 72h long-context regression for int8 vs fp16 on 5k prompt set (elaine + maria)
- create small A/B where 5% of users get fp16 to monitor product metrics (dev-prod)
- re-run quant calibration with new tokenizer patch (maria)

elaine (Eval): I'll prepare the scorecard CSV columns: model_variant, slice, micro-F1, ROUGE-L, human_pref_pct, halluc_rate, p50, p95, cost_per_1M. Will upload to S3 path: s3://redwood-eval/lyra11b/2026-03-xx/scorecard.csv

zhen (SRE): I'll update autoscaler and reserved pools. Need the exact GPU types and expected warm pool percentages from maria.

maria (ML Eng): Deliverables:
- maria: quant calibration + long-context run (ETA 48h)
- elaine: initial scorecard and dashboard widgets (ETA 36h)
- zhen: autoscaler warm-pool + canary policy updates (ETA 24h)
- devin: product copy + 'high fidelity' toggle UX (ETA 72h)

devin (Product): Good. GTN ask: for enterprise customers we should offer a dedicated fp16 plan with SLA and isolation. We'll draft pricing appendix showing int8/default vs fp16-dedicated costs.

maria (ML Eng): Final note: int8 is our recommended unit-econ sweet spot for now. Keep int4 in experiments but gate it behind explicit cost-savings experiments and tighter eval thresholds.

samir (Research): +1 on that. We'll reconvene after the 72h runs.

zhen (SRE): acknowledged. I'll monitor ops-bot canary and set alert for latency tail > 2x baseline.

maria (ML Eng): Thanks all, I'll post the full run logs and the calibration script in the thread when ready.
